steps.title: After the Tyrant appears
steps.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → at D; 3 → at A; 1 → at C.

OffTank.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → at B; 3 → at C; 1 → at A.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → S wall; 3 → NW wall; 1 → E wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → S wall; 3 → W wall; 1 → NE wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → at B; 3 → at C; 1 → at A.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → SW wall; 3 → W wall; 1 → SE wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on OpenSide: 0 → S wall; 3 → SW wall; 1 → E wall.

steps.title: After eye of the Hurricane hits you
steps.cue: Eye of the Hurricane hits you
steps.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

steps.title: After raw Steel Trophy cast starts
steps.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → SW wall; false → near C (S 7m).

MainTank.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → near A (N 6m); false → NW 7m.

OffTank.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → near A (N 6m); false → NE 7m.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → SE wall; false → near C (S 7m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → SW 7m; false → near C (S 7m).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → SE 7m; false → near C (S 7m).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on Mirrored: true → SE wall; false → near C (S 7m).

steps.title: After raw Steel hits you
steps.rule: Go to 2m south of the centre.

steps.title: After ultimate Trophy Weapons resolves
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: HeavyWeightTarget).
